details: On August 19, President Trump is expected to attend a White House summit with leading cryptocurrency and prediction market executives to discuss digital asset policy. This meeting follows the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) proposing "Regulation Crypto Assets" on August 18, which aims to establish a clearer framework for certain crypto-related investment contracts and capital raising, offering exemptions from registration requirements. These developments come as the broader CLARITY Act legislation remains stalled in the Senate.
title: White House Hosts Crypto Leaders Amid New SEC Regulation Push

details: The continuing conflict in the Middle East involving the U.S. and Iran is maintaining a significant risk premium on crude oil prices. This geopolitical tension contributes to inflationary pressures and market uncertainty, influencing global financial stability and prompting investors to seek defensive assets. The lack of a clear resolution suggests crude prices are likely to retain this risk premium.
title: Ongoing Iran-US Conflict Sustains Oil Prices, Fuels Geopolitical Risk

details: The United States and Japan confirmed a joint yen-buying intervention on August 3, the first such action since 1998, in response to the yen reaching a roughly 40-year low. This intervention by major international players aims to stabilize currency markets. Concurrently, markets are anticipating the release of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting minutes on August 19, which will offer insights into the Federal Reserve's future interest rate policy following recent weaker jobs data. Lower rate hike expectations and efforts to counteract dollar strength could ease liquidity for risk assets.
title: US & Japan Intervene to Bolster Yen; Fed Minutes Awaited

details: Ripple's prime brokerage arm, Ripple Prime, successfully completed its first debt offering on August 18, raising $275 million through a private placement of senior unsecured notes. These investment-grade notes, rated BBB by KBRA, mature in 2031 and carry an 8.25% coupon. This financing initiative allows Ripple Prime to expand its operations and compete in areas traditionally dominated by established financial institutions.
title: Ripple Prime Secures $275 Million Debt Offering
